messages:
jordan: quick sanity check — HF->Redwood conversion for `fast-embed-1` showed a CLS pooling / truncation mismatch; reranker MAP dropped ~4% on dev. anyone seen this?

maria: yep saw that in yesterday's quant run. looks like tokenizer added a leading <s> and we ended up with CLS at index 1 instead of 0 :facepalm:

kevin: can you paste the converted `tokenizer.json` + `config.json` snippets?

jordan: sure — snippet from the converted files:
```json
{"special_tokens": {"cls_token": "<s>", "sep_token": "</s>"}, "model_type": "fast-embed", "pooling": "cls"}
```
and the HF tokenizer originally had `add_prefix_space: true` which the bridge removed during conversion.

maria: Ah — so the converter dropped `special_tokens_map` semantics and our pooling code assumes CLS at position 0. If HF prepends a token, all offsets shift and truncation chops important suffix context.

kevin: that matches the eval logs — token offsets off by one for ~12% of queries, reranker features misaligned.

jordan: quick experiment: forced mean pooling instead of cls and MAP recovered ~2.8% of the regression. int8 quant still shows small degradation (~1.5% MAP).

eval-bot: Eval results uploaded: https://internal/reports/1976543210 — fast-embed-1 / int8 / cls-vs-mean

maria: proposed next steps:
- patch hf->redwood bridge to preserve `special_tokens_map.json` and `add_prefix_space` flags
- add converter unit test asserting CLS index mapping vs HF
- add fallback: if CLS token not at expected index, fallback to mean pooling for embeddings
- re-run quant ablation (int8, int4) after tokenizer fix

kevin: I'll own the bridge patch. adding a small migration test to catch this. planning to push a PR today.

jordan: I'll queue the ablation on dedicated GPUs (estimate 4h wall time). will include full reranker eval and a sanity embedding similarity heatmap.

maria: also note: chat templates that include system tokens (e.g. `<s>system</s>`) can change truncation window computation — add a migration note in `model-onboarding.md`.

kevin: opened PR #427 on converter with initial fix + test. also added a converter flag `--preserve-special-tokens`.

jordan: nice. after PR lands I'll re-run onboarding pipeline and post results in this thread.

maria: leaving a short checklist in the model folder and adding a regression alert in case post-rollout perf drops. :thumbsup:
